datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Burkina Faso to assess acute food insecurity conditions using the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) framework. Survey results were spatially mapped and classified into IPC phases representing food insecurity severity. Medium-term projections for October-December 2020 were generated based on these assessments and distributed as geographic data.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity outcomes driven by underlying hazards including drought.
